name: supermarket-stock-system
description: Supermarket inventory with admin and employee roles: products, categories, employees and an audited stock movement history.

scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test:e2e -w frontend
